conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER: The one candidate partial end, a revocation dated 2017-01-19 with no named instrument or scope, is the Department of Labor's own implementing notice published that day (82 FR 6653, FR Doc. 2017-01289). Read in full, it states that Secretary's Order 4-2008 of August 4, 2008 is superseded and canceled and that Executive Order 13755 revoked Executive Order 13245. It is a departmental order issued pursuant to Executive Order 13755 and revokes the earlier departmental order, not Executive Order 13755 or any of its clauses.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 13755 (81 FR 96329, signed 2016-12-23, published 2016-12-30, FR Doc. 2016-31792) was read in full from the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13755.txt, the registered official original. Number, date, title and signature date match the register. The 23-clause inventory (the opening authority words, Section 1 with items (a) through (p), Section 2(a) through (c), Section 3 and Section 4) covers the whole text. The order is an order of succession under the Federal Vacancies Reform Act of 1998 and is not emergency-dependent. Every clause is recorded as continuing on 2026-10-14 because the order has no own-terms end and no held later instrument revokes, supersedes or amends any clause. A prior unfiled lifecycle draft for this order was read and is consistent with this reading; this claim relies on its own checks.
